data.value: Extracts technical media information and routes selected STRM playback through an in-process gateway.

data.name: Enabled
data.value: Enable plugin

data.name: PlaybackMode
data.value: Playback routing mode

data.name: PlaybackModeDescription
data.value: Applies only to STRM items in included libraries. Adaptive (recommended): automatically chooses direct access or relay. For ordinary file direct play, the player reads from the validated source address and media data bypasses Emby; if address reuse fails validation, that playback context temporarily uses Emby relay. Transcoding and HLS are relayed through Emby, with fast positioning for remote TS/M2TS during server-side processing. RedirectOnly: always returns a usable validated source address for direct access by the requester. RelayOnly: always relays media data through Emby, for players that cannot reach the source directly. Native: uses Emby's original playback flow.

data.name: DetectedRedirectHostsDescription
data.value: Select only pending hostnames you trust and save. Trusted detections remain listed and marked; saving new trust automatically retries waiting media. You can also enter exact hosts, IP ranges, or an explicit subdomain rule such as *.example.com below. Full URLs, paths, and query strings are never retained.
